items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: The transcript appears to be a garbled or mis-transcribed song lyric ('I met Jim Tide in the honey stew') rather than a factual statement of personal acquaintance. Without clear context establishing a real-world relationship, the baseline 'knows of' applies.

ctx.x: And I'm Dick Allen. Okay. So we've got everybody's name here. We'll turn the machine off and get you set up to sing again.

Remember, when you're ready, go ahead. Okay. Ready now? Mm-hmm. Bo-leg rooster, duck-leg hen. Made a little date about half past ten. Was it sad? Our boy was bad. Well, the rooster crowed in the hen. Turned around. You want a romance? You gotta run me down. Sad. I was bad. I went all the way to the fiscal bay to the rocks around the coast of Maine. As Mexico and Canada, well, I traveled back again. Well, I met Jim Tide in the honey stew. Tough as a cop cut beat. Well, I've been there live by a dog-gone jail in…
Good. When you're ready, go ahead.
